title: Build a goal to completion: expansion runs, next-node proposals, parallel seats
description:
Filed by architect-16a01670 from parent task-e7a3d643bde34da7b27495dbda745739 (epic breakdown, human-directed 2026-09-04).

PRODUCT GAP (README, re-measured 2026-09-04): 'an initial plan seals one node, so a goal is built one node at a time and growth goes through a successor goal.' Measured: core finalize refuses multi-node INITIAL runs (`packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-submission.ts` MULTI_NODE_EXECUTION_UNSUPPORTED, design 396/1322 - a FENCE, keep it); the compiler mirrors it (`apps/daemon/src/planning/compile-dispatcher.ts:192-197` SUBMIT_DECOMPOSITION_MULTI_NODE_INITIAL). Core already models `PlanningRunKind = INITIAL|REVISION|EXPANSION` with EXPANSION_PLANNING holds and sealed expansion proposals (`packages/core/src/planning/planning-command-contract.ts:11,138-202`, planning-event-contract.ts:49-115), and DONE rows landed the expansion prerequisites (task-671cdd10 'select the durable released attempt for an expansion parent', task-e62e3828 'current expansion safe-release evidence') - but NO expansion kind is published on the daemon vocabulary (`grep -c request_expansion apps/daemon/src/daemon-command-vocabulary.ts` = 0). Growth today = REPLAN successor goal (apps/control-room/src/v2/approvals/replan-successor-port.ts).

FEATURE: after a node is accepted and landed (COMMITTED `moe-landing-receipt/1`), the daemon opens an EXPANSION planning run on the SAME goal; the wrapper staffs a planning seat whose mission carries the approved contract plus the coverage read's UNCOVERED criteria (`POST /documents/coverage/read`); the seat submits the next node(s) through the MCP `planning.submit_decomposition` path extended for EXPANSION (multi-node is allowed there by core design; HARD edges between dependent nodes); the human approves the expansion in the browser (plan-approval card reused, one decision); the wrapper staffs EVERY READY unclaimed node - independent nodes in parallel, bounded by a durable per-project seat limit (default 2) shown on Seats; the goal is 'ready to close' only when every approved criterion is covered. No successor goal for growth (REPLAN stays for exhausted reviews).

ALSO FIX (measured 2026-09-04 on UnAI goal-c9d9850b, memory real-seat-cannot-release-its-claim-2026-09-04): `work_get_context` ignores its `workItemId` (60 KB global dump; claimAggregateVersion unreachable when the harness truncates) and `EXPECTED_VERSION_CONFLICT` carries no observed version, so a real seat cannot `work_release` and its claim lapses at the 30-min TTL. This row makes work_get_context honour workItemId (or returns claimAggregateVersion in the work_claim receipt) and puts `observedVersion` in the refusal details - a multi-node goal cannot be staffed twice without it.

UI: the board (PR #23, apps/control-room/src/v2/board/) shows every node across its six columns; the goal status strip reads 'N of M criteria covered - expansion proposed / awaiting your approval / building'; Needs-you gets 'Approve expansion' (offer-wire pattern); Seats shows the concurrency limit.

DESIGN CONSTRAINT: never relax the INITIAL one-node fence; route growth through EXPANSION (memory initial-run-seals-one-node-by-core-design).
definitionOfDone: Daemon publishes the expansion kinds (architect names them, e.g. `graph.request_expansion` plus the EXPANSION arm of planning.submit_decomposition) with the full roster backfill (vocabulary, registry ROWS + REGISTRATION_ORDER + size pins, families, v2 registry, MCP allowlist/exclusions, generated client + every digest mirror); roster tests assert set-equality in both directions.

e2e over a REAL daemon with a scripted seat double on the real MCP wire: node 1 lands -> expansion run opened -> 2 nodes proposed -> approved in the browser -> both staffed -> delivered, verified, landed on the SAME goal; the goal reaches ready-to-close only at 100% criteria coverage; assert node count = 3 and every criterion VERIFIED on the coverage read.

Wrapper test: two independent READY nodes produce two SPAWNED seats before either exits; a HARD-dependent node is not staffed until its parent is DONE; the durable per-project limit (default 2) is honoured and disclosed on /sessions/read.

`work_get_context {workItemId}` returns that item's claim only (claimAggregateVersion present, response under 8 KB for one item) and `EXPECTED_VERSION_CONFLICT` details carry `observedVersion`; a seat-double test releases its claim on the first try; the refusal test asserts code + layer + observedVersion.
Core fence untouched: the MULTI_NODE_EXECUTION_UNSUPPORTED arm still refuses a 2-node INITIAL run, and mutating compile-dispatcher.ts to allow it turns that test red (drill recorded in a step note).

Live drive on UnAI (goal-c9d9850b or a fresh goal): a second node proposed, approved and landed on the same goal - transcript + landing shas in a row comment; README 'one node at a time' sentence rewritten to the measured truth.
Gates quoted with their count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm test:e2e`.
taskRails: FULL VERTICAL SLICE (human DoD 2026-09-04): this row ships daemon + control-room UI + tests + docs for its feature and carries NO dependsOn on any sibling row of this epic. If the plan exceeds the daemon's thresholds (12 steps / 10 files), the planning architect SPIDR-splits into children under THIS row (parentTaskId); children may depend on each other, never on a sibling feature row.

FEATURES ONLY (human DoD 2026-09-04): no security-boundary or policy work in this row. The verifier stays the documented trusted-workspace v0.1 limitation; signing, hermetic verification and freeze manifests are out of scope.

HUMAN GATES ARE HUMAN-ONLY: every approve/decide kind this row adds is operator-only, listed in HUMAN_ONLY_STEPS and MCP-excluded; every refusal carries a stable code asserted by a test (global rail 1); roster tests are bidirectional set-equality (global rail 9). A new daemon read/command follows the 8-touchpoint + .js bridge pattern (memory ui-connect-everything-built-2026-09-02).

PROVE IT LIVE: besides an offline e2e over a REAL daemon (no fixtures), completion records a live drive on the lane (UnAI at D:/projexts/UnAI or a fresh project): transcript, store path and sha in a row comment (keep each comment under 4500 chars). Never restart the wrapper to unstick a seat (claim TTL 30 min, memory real-seat-cannot-release-its-claim-2026-09-04).

implementationPlan.description: SPIDR ROLL-UP GATE. This row is a parent shell: all production work lives in its six children and it carries dependsOn on every one, so it is not claimable for WORKING until they are all DONE. Confirm that on arrival rather than assuming it: read get_context.epicSiblings (or `git log moe/work-2026-09-04 --grep 'Moe-Task: <id>'`) for each of task-6c05745519844bf39cdebca6d75bb72a (observedVersion), task-f79d38b119984ae1ae51eba887a28b7d (compiler seals the DAG), task-1d7b9df2579c491992b55de791c99f4f (dependency gate), task-92d84d384e4443d7bf78c76024af5688 (parallel seats + limit disclosed), task-0b26dc9e8582428ea1af8032d9277550 (status-strip words), task-b8a389bb78604b2e8224f0bd11675ee3 (e2e + live drive + README). Record each child's landing sha and its completionSummary/reviewSummary in a step note. Per global rail 11 read those summaries instead of re-measuring HEAD. If any child is not DONE, report_blocked with blockedOnTaskIds naming it — the row auto-unblocks when they land. Write no production code in this step.

RECONCILE THE PARENT DoD AGAINST THE OWNER RULING, in a step note, one line per DoD item, before touching anything. The authority is comment-fbe64776 (owner ruling, 'lift the fence') as amended by comment-78d5673f97044d9cbd271c29a1cf3a62 (the planning measurement). The mapping: DoD 1 is REPLACED by DoD 1' (the compiler admits N nodes; the expansion kinds and their roster backfill are OUT) and is discharged by task-f79d38b1. DoD 2 stands with 'expansion run' read as 'the sealed multi-node INITIAL graph', discharged by task-b8a389bb. DoD 3 is discharged by task-92d84d38, with the owner's REPL decision that the limit exposes the existing MOE_WRAPPER_MAX_AGENTS knob. DoD 4 is HALF ALREADY CLOSED AT HEAD — `apps/daemon/src/mcp-work-context-query.ts` honours workItemId — and its open half (observedVersion) is discharged by task-6c057455; re-run `grep -n workItemId apps/daemon/src/mcp-work-context-query.ts` and quote it as the evidence rather than asserting it. DoD 5 is REPLACED by DoD 5' (the dependency gate), discharged by task-1d7b9df2; the literal DoD 5 is UNSATISFIABLE because the core arm it names no longer exists — quote `git grep -n MULTI_NODE_EXECUTION_UNSUPPORTED` (3 hits, none a live refusal) as the proof, and do NOT reintroduce the fence to satisfy the retired wording. DoD 6 and 7 are discharged by task-b8a389bb.

RUN THE FULL GATE SET AT THE INTEGRATED TREE — the composed feature, not any one child's slice. Run each leg as a standalone foreground command and quote its `Test Files N passed` count line verbatim; an exit-0 leg with no count line is UNVERIFIED and must not be reported as a pass (global rail 8). Legs: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/core test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/store test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm test:e2e`. State explicitly in the note that `pnpm test` runs ZERO tests under apps/** (global rail 18), so the two --filter app legs are what cover the daemon and the control room. For any red, attribute it by the merge-base/HEAD delta intersected with this row's owned paths (global rail 3) and quote the foreign red verbatim rather than hiding it. The one named verification command for this row's completion record is `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`; its fresh output is the complete_task evidence.

ADVERSARIAL PASS OVER THE COMPOSED FEATURE, recorded in a step note. task-b8a389bb owns the adversarial pass over its own e2e; this step is the INTEGRATION-level read that only the parent can do, across all six diffs at once. Answer at minimum: (a) does the dependency gate agree with the board — `affordance-read.ts` and `runs-read.ts:98-104` must derive build order from the same edges, or the surface will block a node the board shows as ready; (b) can a dependsOn cycle reach the surface at all, or does `compiled-authority-bodies.ts:62-70` refuse it first (it must refuse at compile, never deadlock the surface); (c) with the seat limit at 1, does a 3-node graph still finish, or does some pass starve; (d) does the new observedVersion member change any decision record shape that a roster or literal-object test pins (global rail 19); (e) two wrapper passes racing on the same READY node — is the claim the only fence. Where an answer is 'not covered', add it as a DoD item on the child that owns the surface, or as a comment on this row — do not file a new evidence row (global rail 21).

COMPLETE THE ROLL-UP. Write the completion record naming, item by item, which child discharged which parent DoD clause and where the evidence lives (each child's task.verification, completionSummary and reviewSummary, plus the landing shas from step 1) — a summary that only says 'children landed' does not discharge the parent. State plainly that DoD 1 and DoD 5 were superseded by owner ruling comment-fbe64776 and that DoD 5 as literally written is unsatisfiable at HEAD, so QA grades 1' and 5'. Detail that exceeds the 2000-char completionSummary cap (the per-child sha list, the gate count lines, the adversarial answers) goes in a row comment under ~4500 chars, one idea per comment (global rail 14). This row writes no production code: if the roll-up finds a real gap, comment on the owning child and report_blocked on it rather than patching here.

comments.author: architect-16a01670
comments.content:
OWNER RULING 2026-09-04 (relayed by session moe-next-67 from the owner's words "lift the fence"): LIFT THE ONE-NODE FENCE. An INITIAL run seals the WHOLE graph; growth through expansion runs is a later path, not this row's.

Measured at main 68eb1c5d: the core fence this row's DoD 5 says to keep no longer exists - `MULTI_NODE_EXECUTION_UNSUPPORTED` was removed by 63efd3a3 "feat(core): admit v2 multi-node planning" (2026-08-31); `packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-submission.ts:131-155` now refuses only a run with ZERO execution-bearing nodes. What remains is (1) `apps/daemon/src/planning/compile-dispatcher.ts:196-197` `if (nodes.length > 1) return refused("SUBMIT_DECOMPOSITION_MULTI_NODE_INITIAL")`, (2) the mission sentence `apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/agent-mission-text.ts:101` "Plan the SMALLEST COMPLETE SLICE: exactly ONE node in an INITIAL run", and (3) NO dependency gate: `apps/daemon/src/http/affordance-read.ts:336-410` offers EVERY node of an approved plan as READY at once and never reads `dependsOn`, and the wrapper (`agent-wrapper.ts:349-360`) staffs any READY unclaimed step up to maxAgents.

AMENDED SCOPE (replaces DoD 1 and DoD 5; DoD 2/3/4/6/7 stand with "expansion run" read as "the sealed multi-node INITIAL graph"):
- DoD 1' : `compile-dispatcher.ts` admits N>=1 nodes; `SUBMIT_DECOMPOSITION_MULTI_NODE_INITIAL` is retired from its code roster (roster test updated, not skipped); the compiler mission tells the seat to plan the COMPLETE graph as a dependency DAG (every criterion of the approved revision covered exactly once across nodes, `dependsOn` naming hard build order), and a mission-text test pins the new sentence.
- DoD 5' : a node.deliver step is READY only when every `dependsOn` node is ACCEPTED; otherwise the surface lists it BLOCKED with `missing: ["depends:<nodeKey>", ...]` (MISSING_TOKENS roster + wrapper test: the dependent node is NOT staffed while its parent is un-accepted, IS staffed on the next pass after acceptance). The board (PR #23) already renders such a node as QUEUED "after <nodeKey>".
- The expansion kinds (`graph.request_expansion` etc.) are OUT of this row; file a separate row if growing a live goal is still wanted after this lands.
Planner: read this comment before submit_plan; the row's description still argues for the fence and is superseded here.

comments.author: architect-20a6d1eb
comments.content:
PLANNING MEASUREMENT + SPIDR SPLIT (architect-20a6d1eb, 2026-09-04, branch moe/work-2026-09-04). Global rail 6 re-measure: this row's description is STALE IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. Commands and results:

(1) CORE FENCE IS GONE — DoD 5 is unsatisfiable as written. `packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-submission.ts` `finalize` refuses only `executionBearingKeys(witness).length === 0`; there is no runKind or node-count arm. `git grep -n MULTI_NODE_EXECUTION_UNSUPPORTED` = 3 hits, NONE of them a live refusal: planning-event-contract.ts:171 (code roster string), planning-invariants.test.ts:32 (asserts the code is NOT driven), goal-close-readiness.test.ts:18 (a prose comment stating the retired rule). DoD 5 says "the MULTI_NODE_EXECUTION_UNSUPPORTED arm still refuses a 2-node INITIAL run" — that arm does not exist, so the clause cannot be discharged. This confirms owner ruling comment-fbe64776 independently.

(2) EXPANSION IS MOSTLY BUILT, and is OUT by that ruling. `graph.request_expansion` has a full daemon slice (expansion-request-contracts/derivation/records/current-authority/ledger/commit/service) and its edge is WIRED at `daemon-command-graph-edges.ts:191`; it is published in `packages/contracts/src/runtime/runtime-vocabulary.ts:96` and in the generated client. Only `apps/daemon/src/daemon-command-vocabulary.ts` lacks it (the description's `grep -c` = 0 is true but measures one file of many). Planning expansion work would have duplicated a landed surface.

(3) `work_get_context {workItemId}` IS ALREADY FIXED — half of DoD 4 is closed. `apps/daemon/src/mcp-work-context-query.ts` (152 ln) narrows to one item (`stepFor`, `WORK_ITEM_UNKNOWN`, `INPUT_INVALID`), serialises `claimAggregateVersion` FIRST against harness truncation, is wired at `mcp-dispatch-port.ts:22`, has its `.js` bridge. The OPEN half is `observedVersion`: `store-contracts.ts:140-151` `NoBusinessEffectDecision` has no such member, though the value is already computed at `decision-ledger-canonical.ts:204-207`.

(4) PARALLEL STAFFING ALREADY WORKS — DoD 3 overstates the gap. `agent-wrapper.ts:339-371` staffs every READY unclaimed step in one pass, breaking at `activeCount() >= config.maxAgents` (line 356); `wrapper-knobs.ts:30` `DEFAULT_MAX_AGENTS = 2`. Missing: disclosure on /sessions/read + the proof tests.

(5) MUCH OF THE UI IS BUILT. `/runs/read` already emits per-node `dependsOn` (runs-read.ts:98-104, from `snapshot.edges`); the board already renders `after <nodeKey>` (board-columns.ts:73) and a "Depends on" field (board-lanes.tsx:77); `goal-status.ts:139-143` already gates READY_TO_CLOSE on `progress.verified === progress.criteria` from the coverage read.

(6) THE REAL GAP is the dependency gate: `affordance-read.ts:363-410` derives node status from the review ledger ALONE — the word `dependsOn` does not appear in the file — so every un-accepted node is offered READY at once. The fact needed to fix it is already sealed (`compile-dispatcher.ts:220` -> `snapshot.edges` + `nodeAuthority.definitions[].directHardDependencies`), so no core/scheduler change is required.

OWNER DECISION taken in the planning REPL 2026-09-04: the per-project seat limit EXPOSES the existing `MOE_WRAPPER_MAX_AGENTS` env knob (default 2). No durable store-backed setting, no new command kind, no roster backfill.

- task-6c057455 observedVersion leaf (no deps)
- task-f79d38b1 compiler seals the whole DAG (no deps)

- task-0b26dc9e status-strip coverage words (needs 1d7b9df2)
- task-b8a389bb e2e + live drive + README + adversarial pass (needs all five)
This parent now carries dependsOn on all six (previously empty — an empty SPIDR parent is claimable with unplanned children).

FOR QA: grade this parent against DoD 1' and 5' from comment-fbe64776, not against DoD 1/5 as written. DoD 2's phrase "expansion run" reads as "the sealed multi-node INITIAL graph". DoD 4's work_get_context clause is discharged by code that already exists at HEAD.

- It IS wired into work-claim: `apps/daemon/src/work/work-claim-services.ts:5` imports it and line 116 passes `conflictError(response.decision)` into `refuse(...)` as the `error` member; `WorkClaimRefused` carries `code`, `refusedBy` AND `error: RuntimeError | null` (lines 44-52).
- It reaches the MCP wire: `apps/daemon/src/daemon-command-dispatch.ts:108-115` `detailOf()` folds the error's details into the refusal detail as sorted `key=value` pairs, so a caller reads `actualVersion=<n>`.
- Tests are at HEAD: `apps/daemon/src/mcp-dispatch-port-conflict.test.ts` exists; `apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/bootstrap-durability.test.ts:344-347` asserts `actualVersion` is read back off the ledger and never copied from the request. The mission-text retry sentence is in at `agent-mission-text.ts:27`.
- Dated against the live evidence: `git cat-file -e d90ef6b5:apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/bootstrap-conflict-error.ts` -> ABSENT, and `git show d90ef6b5:.../work-claim-services.ts | grep -c conflictError` -> 0. The whole capability landed in `1031a7e8`, whose subject is that row's title. So the UnAI seat that could not release at 08:10Z on main d90ef6b5 predates the fix — the memory real-seat-cannot-release-its-claim-2026-09-04 is now STALE as a gap report and I am correcting it.

WHY I MISSED IT, so the next architect does not repeat it: (1) `get_context.epicSiblings` listed only 7 of the epic's 52 rows and did not include task-f99cec0b, so global rail 20's "check epicSiblings before filing" did not surface the owner; (2) my own grep of `work-claim-services.ts` read the `refuse()` SIGNATURE at lines 58-67 and its early ingress call sites, all of which pass three arguments, and I concluded the refusal "carries code/refusedBy only" — the fourth parameter is optional and the ONE call site that supplies it is at line 116, past where I stopped reading. A signature is not a call-site census.

DESIGN NOTE for anyone tempted to re-file this: the delivered design deliberately does NOT add `observedVersion` as a typed member of `NoBusinessEffectDecision` — that row's DoD 2 required "no wire-shape change" and asserts the REFUSED frame's key roster {code, detail, httpStatus, layer} unchanged. The version is decoded from the store's bytes precisely so the daemon never recomputes it ("a daemon-computed version would authenticate nothing — it would just echo what the caller already believed, which is the value that was wrong"). My deleted row's DoD 1 asked for the opposite and would have been a regression.

NET EFFECT ON THIS PARENT: five children remain (f79d38b1 compiler, 1d7b9df2 dependency gate, 92d84d38 parallel seats, 0b26dc9e status strip, b8a389bb e2e/live/README). DoD 4 of this parent is now FULLY discharged by work already at HEAD — `work_get_context {workItemId}` by `apps/daemon/src/mcp-work-context-query.ts`, and the observedVersion half by task-f99cec0b.
